en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the library.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?
Let's read a dirty book
Let's read manga
This is boring...

Do all uncut losers think about pervy shit all
the time, or just you?

At this rate, you'll start gettin' turned on
around bitches in heat!

Who am I kiddin'? I bet you've already jerked
off to a dog at least once!
Hmph! That's actually not a bad idea, virgin!

After all, comic books played a key role in
my sexual awakening!

Alright! I'll tell you exactly how it happened!
And I ain't sparin' a single sordid detail!

So I'm at this Chinese restaurant with my family
and I find this comic book, see? At the time—

<CLT=cltMIND>Is this a story to be
telling in public!?

What? Are you...bored when we're
together?

Uhhhh... And I thought we were about
to go on a date...
Was I the only one...gettin' revved up?

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Miu looks deep in thought...
(Hmph...)
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?
<CLT=cltMIND>That voice just now. Is that...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Is that Miu's inner thoughts...?
